senses.en: An official document allowing police to take a particular action.
To make a particular action necessary or reasonable.
A good reason or justification for something.

ex.en: The officers obtained a warrant before searching the apartment.
ex.zh: 警员在搜查这套公寓前取得了搜查令。

ex.en: The potential environmental risks warrant further investigation before the government approves construction of the new industrial facility.
ex.zh: 在政府批准建设新的工业设施之前，潜在的环境风险值得进一步调查。

col: warrant further investigation｜值得进一步调查
tip: 动词常指值得或有必要，如warrant attention。

senses.en: needed for a particular purpose
something necessary for a particular purpose

ex.en: She has the requisite skills to repair this bicycle.
ex.zh: 她具备修理这辆自行车所必需的技能。

ex.en: Applicants without the requisite qualifications may benefit from training programmes designed to improve access to skilled employment.
ex.zh: 不具备必要资历的申请者或可受益于旨在帮助人们进入技术岗位的培训项目。

col: a requisite for success｜成功的必要条件
tip: 较正式；requisite 指必需，prerequisite 强调先决。

senses.en: The craft of decorating cloth with needle and thread.
Decorative patterns sewn onto cloth using coloured thread.

ex.en: I practise embroidery by stitching flowers onto plain cushions.
ex.zh: 我在素色靠垫上绣花来练习刺绣。

ex.en: Community embroidery workshops can preserve traditional skills while creating opportunities for different generations to learn together.
ex.zh: 社区刺绣工作坊既能保护传统技艺，也能为不同年龄的人创造共同学习的机会。

tip: embroidery通常不可数；动词是embroider。

senses.en: a list of people or organisations with their contact details
a location used to organise files on a computer

ex.en: I found a nearby plumber in the local directory.
ex.zh: 我在本地名录里找到了一位附近的水管工。

ex.en: An online directory of community services can help new residents locate essential support more easily.
ex.zh: 社区服务在线名录可以帮助新居民更轻松地找到必要的支持。

tip: 名录通常含联系方式；计算机中指文件目录。

senses.en: a person living in an area represented by an elected official
one of the parts or substances that form something
forming part of a larger whole

ex.en: A constituent asked her local representative about the closed library.
ex.zh: 一位选区居民向当地民意代表询问图书馆关闭的事。

ex.en: Elected representatives should consult their constituents before supporting policies that significantly affect local housing and public transport.
ex.zh: 民选代表在支持对当地住房和公共交通有重大影响的政策之前，应征询选区居民的意见。

tip: 选民义可含未投票的选区居民；成分义近component。

senses.en: Having a bright red colour
A bright red colour

ex.en: She wore a scarlet scarf against her grey coat.
ex.zh: 她戴着一条鲜红色围巾，衬着灰色外套。

ex.en: In visual advertising, scarlet backgrounds can attract attention, although colour associations vary across cultures.
ex.zh: 在视觉广告中，鲜红色背景能够吸引注意，但不同文化对颜色的联想有所差异。

tip: turn scarlet常形容因尴尬或生气而脸红。

senses.en: the quality of being new, unusual, or unfamiliar
something new or unusual that attracts interest
a small unusual object made mainly for amusement

ex.en: The novelty of sleeping in a tent soon wore off.
ex.zh: 睡帐篷的新鲜感很快就消退了。

ex.en: Although the novelty of new technology attracts consumers, long-term adoption depends on practical benefits and affordability.
ex.zh: 虽然新技术的新颖性会吸引消费者，但长期采用仍取决于实际益处和价格是否可负担。

col: novelty value｜新奇带来的吸引力
the novelty wears off｜新鲜感消退
tip: 指新奇感时不可数；指新鲜事物或小玩意儿时可数。

senses.en: A bluish-white metal also needed in small amounts for health.

ex.en: These pumpkin seeds contain zinc and make a tasty snack.
ex.zh: 这些南瓜籽含有锌，吃起来也是美味的零食。

ex.en: Zinc coatings protect steel from corrosion, extending the lifespan of structures exposed to rain and moisture.
ex.zh: 锌涂层能保护钢材免受腐蚀，延长暴露于雨水和潮气中的结构的使用寿命。

tip: 锌是化学元素，符号Zn；作物质名通常不可数。

senses.en: The scientific study of the mind and behaviour.
The characteristic ways a person or group thinks and behaves.

ex.en: My sister studies psychology and hopes to help children.
ex.zh: 我姐姐学习心理学，希望将来帮助儿童。

ex.en: Research in psychology suggests that regular social interaction can support emotional wellbeing among older adults.
ex.zh: 心理学研究表明，经常进行社交互动有助于维护老年人的情绪健康。

tip: 开头的p不发音；psychologist指心理学家。

senses.en: likely to attack or cause serious harm
deliberately cruel and intended to hurt someone

ex.en: A vicious dog growled behind the tall metal fence.
ex.zh: 一只凶猛的狗在高高的金属围栏后低吼。

ex.en: Vicious comments on social media can damage young people's confidence and discourage participation in online discussions.
ex.zh: 社交媒体上的恶毒评论可能损害年轻人的自信，使他们不愿参与网上讨论。

tip: vicious circle指问题互相加剧的“恶性循环”。

senses.en: a group working together or playing a sport together
to join someone to work together, usually with up

ex.en: Our team celebrated with pizza after winning the match.
ex.zh: 我们队赢得比赛后，吃披萨庆祝了一番。

ex.en: Working in a team helps students develop communication skills that are essential for future employment.
ex.zh: 团队合作有助于学生培养未来就业所必需的沟通能力。

tip: 英式英语中team可接单数或复数谓语。

senses.en: A numerical factor multiplying a variable or measuring a property.

ex.en: Our teacher explained how the coefficient changes the curve.
ex.zh: 老师解释了系数如何改变曲线的形状。

ex.en: A high correlation coefficient indicates a strong statistical relationship, but it does not necessarily establish causation.
ex.zh: 较高的相关系数表明存在较强的统计关联，但不一定能证明因果关系。

tip: 数学中指系数；相关系数高不代表存在因果关系。

senses.en: An object thick at one end and thin at the other.
To push something tightly into a narrow space.

ex.en: He slid a wooden wedge under the heavy door.
ex.zh: 他把一个木楔塞到沉重的门下面。

ex.en: Disagreements over resource allocation can drive a wedge between neighbouring communities and weaken regional cooperation.
ex.zh: 资源分配上的分歧可能导致相邻社区失和，并削弱区域合作。

col: a wedge of cheese｜一块楔形奶酪
wedge the door open｜用楔子撑住门
drive a wedge between｜使……之间产生隔阂
tip: drive a wedge between 比喻挑起隔阂或分裂。

senses.en: A case with a handle for carrying clothes when travelling.

ex.en: Her suitcase was too heavy to lift onto the train.
ex.zh: 她的行李箱太重，搬不上火车。

ex.en: Travellers can reduce transport emissions by packing a lighter suitcase and choosing public transport whenever possible.
ex.zh: 旅客可以通过减轻行李箱的重量，并尽量选择公共交通来减少交通排放。

col: unpack a suitcase｜打开行李箱取出物品
tip: suitcase可数；统称行李的luggage不可数。

senses.en: A number with a fractional part shown after a point.
Using a system based on ten or involving decimal fractions.

ex.en: Our teacher showed us how to multiply two decimals.
ex.zh: 老师教我们如何将两个小数相乘。

ex.en: Students should understand decimal notation before they interpret statistical data in science and economics lessons.
ex.zh: 学生在科学和经济学课堂上解读统计数据之前，应先理解小数记法。

tip: 保留两位小数可说to two decimal places。

senses.en: A path intended for walking rather than driving.

ex.en: A narrow footpath leads from our village to the lake.
ex.zh: 一条狭窄的小径从我们村通向湖边。

ex.en: Maintaining rural footpaths encourages outdoor recreation while helping visitors avoid damage to surrounding farmland.
ex.zh: 维护乡村步道既能鼓励户外休闲，也能帮助游客避免破坏周围的农田。

tip: 常指供步行的小径，不一定紧邻公路。

senses.en: A young dog.

ex.en: The puppy fell asleep inside my empty shoe.
ex.zh: 小狗钻进我的空鞋子里睡着了。

ex.en: Adopting a puppy requires a long-term commitment to training, exercise, and regular veterinary care.
ex.zh: 领养幼犬意味着要长期承担训练、运动和定期兽医护理的责任。

col: a litter of puppies｜一窝幼犬
tip: 复数为puppies；通常专指幼犬。

senses.en: A cupboard or small enclosed space for storing clothes or belongings
Keeping a particular identity, belief, or interest secret

ex.en: I hung my winter coat in the hallway closet.
ex.zh: 我把冬季外套挂进了走廊的壁橱里。

ex.en: Small apartments can feel more spacious when residents organise belongings efficiently and make better use of closet space.
ex.zh: 如果住户高效整理物品，更充分地利用壁橱空间，小公寓也会显得更宽敞。

tip: 衣物收纳义多见于美式英语；英式常用wardrobe。

senses.en: A thin booklet giving information or arguments about a subject

ex.en: The nurse handed me a pamphlet about healthy eating.
ex.zh: 护士递给我一本关于健康饮食的小册子。

ex.en: Public health pamphlets should use clear language and illustrations to explain preventive measures to a broad audience.
ex.zh: 公共卫生宣传册应使用清晰的语言和插图，向广大受众解释预防措施。

col: a pamphlet on health｜健康宣传册
tip: 通常指介绍专题的薄册子，比普通书籍篇幅短。

senses.en: The act of vanishing or becoming impossible to find.
The process of gradually ceasing to exist.

ex.en: The disappearance of my keys made me late again.
ex.zh: 我的钥匙不见了，害得我又迟到了。

ex.en: The gradual disappearance of traditional crafts reflects changing lifestyles and declining demand for handmade goods.
ex.zh: 传统手工艺逐渐消亡，反映出生活方式的变化以及手工制品需求的下降。

tip: 常接of说明消失的人或物；动词为disappear。

senses.en: A special disc or voucher used instead of money.
Something given or done to express a feeling.
Done merely to appear helpful or compliant, with little effect.

ex.en: I dropped a token into the machine and played.
ex.zh: 我往机器里投了一枚代币，开始玩了起来。

ex.en: Critics argue that token environmental measures cannot address the scale of pollution in rapidly expanding cities.
ex.zh: 批评者认为，象征性的环保措施无法应对快速扩张的城市中如此严重的污染。

col: a token of appreciation｜表达谢意的心意
a token gesture｜象征性的举动
a token payment｜象征性的付款
tip: a token of后接情感名词，表示某种心意。

senses.zh: 象牙； 象牙色， 乳白色

senses.en: an introduction that helps people adjust to a new setting
the direction in which something faces or is positioned
a person's or organisation's basic interests, beliefs, or preferences

ex.en: During orientation, a student guide showed us the library.
ex.zh: 入学指导期间，一位学生向导带我们参观了图书馆。

ex.en: A comprehensive orientation programme can help international students understand academic expectations and access essential support services.
ex.zh: 全面的入学指导计划能帮助国际学生了解学业要求，并获得必要的支持服务。

col: orientation programme｜入学或入职指导计划
tip: 入学指导常用orientation；方位义常用于建筑。

senses.en: small balls of ice that fall from clouds
to fall from the sky as small balls of ice
to praise someone publicly or call to attract attention

ex.en: Hail rattled against the windows during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨中，冰雹打在窗户上，发出噼啪声。

ex.en: Scientists hailed the new irrigation system as a breakthrough that could help farmers conserve water during droughts.
ex.zh: 科学家称赞这套新灌溉系统是一项突破，能帮助农民在干旱期间节约用水。

col: hail a taxi｜招手叫出租车
be hailed as a breakthrough｜被誉为一项突破
tip: 下冰雹用it hails；hail A as B指称赞A为B。

senses.en: To want something deeply, especially something difficult to obtain

ex.en: After months abroad, she yearned for her mother's cooking.
ex.zh: 在国外待了几个月后，她十分想念母亲做的饭菜。

ex.en: Many urban residents yearn for quieter surroundings, which may explain the growing appeal of rural tourism.
ex.zh: 许多城市居民渴望更安静的环境，这或许能解释乡村旅游日益增长的吸引力。

tip: 用yearn for sth或yearn to do，表达强烈渴望。

senses.en: A plant substance used to add flavour to food.
To add spices to food.
Something that makes an experience more interesting or exciting.

ex.en: This warming spice gives the soup a lovely flavour.
ex.zh: 这种带来暖意的香料让汤的味道十分美妙。

ex.en: The historical spice trade connected distant societies and encouraged the exchange of agricultural knowledge and cooking techniques.
ex.zh: 历史上的香料贸易连接了遥远的社会，并促进了农业知识与烹饪技术的交流。

tip: spice不一定辣；spice up也可指增添趣味。

senses.en: a substance burned to produce a pleasant smell

ex.en: A thin trail of smoke rose from the incense.
ex.zh: 一缕轻烟从熏香上缓缓升起。

ex.en: Burning incense indoors can affect air quality, particularly in small rooms with inadequate ventilation.
ex.zh: 在室内焚香可能影响空气质量，尤其是在通风不足的小房间里。

tip: 名词重音在前；同形动词重音在后，意为激怒。

senses.en: equally or in the same way throughout
in every case, without any exceptions

ex.en: Spread the butter uniformly across the warm bread.
ex.zh: 把黄油均匀地涂在温热的面包上。

ex.en: Environmental regulations must be applied uniformly to all companies to ensure fair competition.
ex.zh: 环境法规必须统一适用于所有公司，以确保公平竞争。

tip: 强调各处或各例相同，不只是时间上的经常。

senses.en: similarity between people or things, especially in appearance

ex.en: There is a striking resemblance between the two sisters.
ex.zh: 这两姐妹长得非常像。

ex.en: Modern housing developments often bear little resemblance to traditional neighbourhoods, particularly in their layout and use of shared space.
ex.zh: 现代住宅开发项目往往与传统街区大不相同，尤其是在布局和公共空间的使用方面。

col: a family resemblance｜家族成员间的相像
tip: resemblance to后接比较对象；resemble直接接宾语。

senses.en: A comparison used to explain something through a similar example

ex.en: Her analogy compared our busy kitchen to a train station.
ex.zh: 她把我们忙碌的厨房比作火车站。

ex.en: Teachers often draw an analogy between electrical circuits and flowing water to explain unfamiliar scientific concepts.
ex.zh: 教师常将电路与流水作类比，以解释学生不熟悉的科学概念。

col: an analogy between｜两者之间的类比
tip: 常用draw an analogy between A and B。

senses.en: to happen at the same time
to be the same or agree with something

ex.en: My days off rarely coincide with my sister's.
ex.zh: 我的休息日很少和姐姐的重合。

ex.en: Government investment should coincide with local priorities to ensure that public funds address genuine community needs.
ex.zh: 政府投资应与地方优先事项相一致，以确保公共资金满足社区的真实需求。

col: coincide with｜与……同时发生；与……相符
tip: 不及物动词，接对象用with，不直接接宾语。

senses.zh: 线的， 直线的， 线状的； 长度的； 线性的
显微镜的；微观的，极小的

senses.en: in a way that is easy to perceive or remember
to a noticeable or unmistakable degree

ex.en: I distinctly remember leaving my keys beside the kettle.
ex.zh: 我清楚地记得把钥匙放在水壶旁边了。

ex.en: Residents felt distinctly safer after the council improved street lighting and introduced regular evening bus services.
ex.zh: 市政部门改善路灯并开通定时晚间公交后，居民明显感到更安全了。

tip: distinctly可修饰记忆、感知，也可强调程度。

senses.zh: 流言蜚语；爱说长道短的人

senses.en: to walk for pleasure without following a fixed route
to talk at length without a clear focus
a long walk for pleasure, especially in the countryside

ex.en: We rambled through the woods until it started raining.
ex.zh: 我们在树林里漫步，直到下起雨来。

ex.en: Speakers who ramble during presentations may struggle to communicate their main arguments clearly to an audience.
ex.zh: 演讲时漫无边际的人可能难以向听众清晰传达自己的主要论点。

col: ramble through the countryside｜在乡间漫步
ramble on about something｜絮絮叨叨地说某事
tip: ramble on 常指说话冗长散漫，带不耐烦语气。

senses.en: to happen or exist before something else
to go in front of someone or something

ex.en: A short welcome speech will precede the evening meal.
ex.zh: 晚餐前会有一段简短的欢迎致辞。

ex.en: Thorough environmental assessments should precede major construction projects to identify potential risks to local ecosystems.
ex.zh: 大型建设项目启动前应进行全面的环境评估，以识别对当地生态系统的潜在风险。

col: immediately precede｜紧接着发生在……之前
precede the introduction of｜先于……的引入
tip: precede 指先于；proceed 指继续进行。

senses.en: Too small or unimportant to deserve much attention.
Unkindly concerned with small, unimportant matters.
Relatively minor or small in scale, especially concerning crime.

ex.en: We wasted the afternoon arguing over petty details.
ex.zh: 我们整个下午都浪费在争论琐碎细节上了。

ex.en: Investment in youth services may help reduce petty crime by providing constructive activities and support.
ex.zh: 投资青少年服务，为他们提供有益活动和支持，可能有助于减少轻微犯罪。

tip: 形容人时常含贬义，指小心眼，不只是小气。

senses.en: A very thin thread or thread-like structure.
A thin wire that produces light when heated by electricity.

ex.en: A delicate filament stretched between the spider and the branch.
ex.zh: 蜘蛛与树枝之间牵着一根纤细的丝。

ex.en: Researchers are developing stronger filaments for use in lightweight materials that could reduce fuel consumption in transport.
ex.zh: 研究人员正在研发更强韧的细丝，用于可降低运输燃料消耗的轻质材料。

tip: 既指一般细丝，也指灯泡中通电发光的灯丝。

senses.en: A microscopic single-celled organism, sometimes responsible for disease.

ex.en: Under the microscope, a single bacterium moved slowly.
ex.zh: 显微镜下，一个细菌缓缓移动。

ex.en: Scientists identified a bacterium that could help remove harmful chemicals from polluted soil without damaging nearby plants.
ex.zh: 科学家发现了一种细菌，可帮助去除受污染土壤中的有害化学物质，同时不伤害附近的植物。

tip: 单数bacterium，复数bacteria；复数作主语用are。

senses.en: A range of related ideas, qualities, or possibilities
A range of colours or waves arranged by wavelength or frequency

ex.en: Our book club welcomes a wide spectrum of opinions.
ex.zh: 我们的读书会欢迎各种不同的观点。

ex.en: Universities should provide support for students across the entire spectrum of academic abilities and social backgrounds.
ex.zh: 大学应为各种学业水平和社会背景的学生提供支持。

col: a broad spectrum of｜广泛的各种……
across the spectrum｜涵盖整个范围
tip: 复数可用spectra或spectrums。

senses.en: A narrow sticky strip used to attach or seal things.
A magnetic strip used to record sound, images, or data.
Attach or secure something using sticky tape.

ex.en: I sealed the parcel with a strip of tape.
ex.zh: 我用一条胶带封好了包裹。

ex.en: Older interviews stored on magnetic tape should be digitised to preserve valuable records for future historical research.
ex.zh: 保存在磁带上的早期访谈应进行数字化处理，为未来的历史研究保存珍贵记录。

col: a roll of tape｜一卷胶带
tip: 胶带通常不可数；一卷胶带说a roll of tape。

senses.en: A building where people watch plays and other live performances.
The activity or art of writing, producing, and performing plays.
A specially equipped room in a hospital where operations happen.

ex.en: We arrived at the theatre just before the play started.
ex.zh: 我们在话剧开演前刚好赶到了剧院。

ex.en: Public funding for theatre can make live performances accessible to audiences who cannot afford expensive tickets.
ex.zh: 对戏剧的公共资助能让买不起高价门票的观众也有机会观看现场演出。

col: go to the theatre｜去剧院看戏
tip: 英式拼写theatre，美式常写theater；英式电影院用cinema。

senses.en: To satisfy thirst or a strong desire.
To put out a fire or stop flames burning.

ex.en: Cold water quenched my thirst after the long walk.
ex.zh: 走了很长一段路后，凉水解了我的渴。

ex.en: Public drinking fountains allow residents to quench their thirst without buying bottled water, reducing plastic waste.
ex.zh: 公共饮水设施让居民无需购买瓶装水就能解渴，从而减少塑料垃圾。

col: quench a thirst for knowledge｜满足求知欲
tip: 最常见搭配是quench one's thirst，表示解渴。

senses.en: In a way related to the body or physical effort.
In a real, material way rather than virtually or theoretically.

ex.en: After moving those boxes, I felt physically exhausted.
ex.zh: 搬完那些箱子后，我感觉身体疲惫不堪。

ex.en: Physically active children often develop healthier habits that continue into adulthood, reducing their risk of chronic disease.
ex.zh: 经常运动的儿童通常会养成更健康的习惯，并延续至成年，从而降低患慢性病的风险。

tip: 强调身体层面时，常与mentally形成对比。

senses.en: Too small or unimportant to have much effect.

ex.en: The scratch is insignificant compared with the broken window.
ex.zh: 与破碎的窗户相比，这道划痕微不足道。

ex.en: Although individual savings may seem insignificant, widespread reductions in energy use can produce substantial environmental benefits.
ex.zh: 虽然个人节省的能源可能看似微不足道，但大范围降低能耗能够带来显著的环境效益。

col: an insignificant amount｜微不足道的量
tip: 强调不重要或影响小，不等同于meaningless。

senses.en: not restricted in amount, number, or extent

ex.en: Our hotel offers unlimited coffee with breakfast each morning.
ex.zh: 我们住的酒店每天早餐都提供不限量的咖啡。

ex.en: Economic growth cannot rely on unlimited consumption of natural resources without causing serious environmental damage.
ex.zh: 经济增长若依赖无限消耗自然资源，就必然会造成严重的环境破坏。

tip: 表示没有限制；不等于 uncertain（不确定的）。

senses.en: Too many to count.

ex.en: Innumerable stars filled the sky above our quiet campsite.
ex.zh: 无数星星布满了我们宁静营地上方的夜空。

ex.en: Coastal wetlands support innumerable organisms and provide essential protection against storms for nearby communities.
ex.zh: 沿海湿地养育着无数生物，并为附近社区提供抵御风暴的重要屏障。

tip: 后接可数名词复数，语气比many强，较正式。

senses.en: relating to substances generally without carbon bonded to hydrogen

ex.en: Today we examined inorganic compounds, including salt, in science class.
ex.zh: 今天科学课上，我们研究了包括盐在内的无机化合物。

ex.en: Excessive use of inorganic fertilisers can damage soil quality and contribute to pollution in nearby rivers.
ex.zh: 过量使用无机肥料可能损害土壤质量，并造成附近河流污染。

tip: 无机物并非都不含碳，如二氧化碳也是无机物。

senses.en: Determined to succeed without caring about harm caused to others.

ex.en: The ruthless landlord evicted the family without any warning.
ex.zh: 那个冷酷无情的房东毫无预警地赶走了这家人。

ex.en: Ruthless competition may encourage companies to cut labour costs at the expense of employee welfare.
ex.zh: 残酷的竞争可能促使企业以牺牲员工福利为代价来削减用工成本。

col: a ruthless leader｜冷酷无情的领导者
tip: 比strict更强，强调为达目的而不顾他人感受或利益。

senses.en: thick or disgusting dirt
sexual material or language considered extremely offensive

ex.en: My boots were covered in filth after the walk.
ex.zh: 散步回来后，我的靴子上沾满了污物。

ex.en: Without regular waste collection, filth can accumulate in residential areas and create serious public health risks.
ex.zh: 如果不定期收运垃圾，住宅区就可能积聚污物，造成严重的公共卫生风险。

col: live in filth｜生活在污秽环境中
tip: 不可数，比dirt语气强，常带厌恶感。

senses.zh: 嗡嗡声， 营营声， 嘈杂声

senses.en: A remark expressing admiration or approval.
To tell someone that you admire something about them.

ex.en: Her compliment about my cooking made me smile.
ex.zh: 她对我厨艺的称赞让我笑了。

ex.en: Teachers who compliment students on specific improvements can strengthen motivation and encourage continued effort.
ex.zh: 教师若针对学生的具体进步给予表扬，就能增强学习动力，鼓励他们继续努力。

col: pay someone a compliment｜称赞某人
compliment someone on something｜称赞某人的某方面
tip: compliment是赞美；complement是补充、相辅相成。

senses.en: Unable to read or write.
Lacking basic knowledge or skills in a particular area.

ex.en: Her grandfather was illiterate but told wonderful bedtime stories.
ex.zh: 她的祖父虽然不识字，却很会讲睡前故事。

ex.en: Free adult education can help illiterate citizens develop essential skills and participate more fully in society.
ex.zh: 免费的成人教育能够帮助不识字的公民掌握基本技能，更充分地参与社会生活。

tip: 名词用法易显贬义，宜用形容词客观描述。

senses.en: Materials used for writing, such as paper, pens, and envelopes.

ex.en: I bought some stationery for my new evening class.
ex.zh: 我为新报的夜校课程买了些文具。

ex.en: Providing basic stationery can help disadvantaged students participate more fully in classroom activities and complete assignments.
ex.zh: 提供基本文具可以帮助弱势学生更充分地参与课堂活动并完成作业。

tip: 不可数；勿与stationary（静止的）混淆。

senses.en: to eat growing grass, or let animals feed on it
to scrape skin slightly or touch something while passing
a small injury where skin has been scraped off

ex.en: Sheep graze quietly beside the river every summer morning.
ex.zh: 每个夏日清晨，羊群都在河边安静地吃草。

ex.en: Allowing cattle to graze too intensively can damage vegetation and increase the risk of soil erosion.
ex.zh: 让牛群过度放牧会破坏植被，并增加水土流失的风险。

tip: 动物吃草可说graze on grass；graze cattle指放牛。

senses.en: located in a particular place
in a particular set of circumstances

ex.en: Our hotel is situated beside a quiet mountain lake.
ex.zh: 我们的酒店坐落在一处宁静的高山湖泊旁。

ex.en: Schools situated near busy roads may need additional measures to protect pupils from air pollution.
ex.zh: 位于繁忙道路附近的学校可能需要采取额外措施，保护学生免受空气污染的影响。

tip: 常用be situated in/near，描述位置，较正式。

senses.en: Someone awarded a first university degree
A man who has never married

ex.en: My cousin earned a bachelor's degree in engineering.
ex.zh: 我的表哥获得了工程学学士学位。

ex.en: A bachelor's degree can improve employment prospects, although practical experience remains important in many industries.
ex.zh: 学士学位可以改善就业前景，但在许多行业中，实践经验仍然重要。

col: eligible bachelor｜条件优越的未婚男子
tip: 学士学位写作bachelor's degree，注意所有格。

senses.en: Done or working without receiving money.
Not yet paid or settled.

ex.en: She does unpaid work at the animal shelter every Saturday.
ex.zh: 她每周六都在动物收容所做无偿工作。

ex.en: Unpaid internships can disadvantage students who cannot afford to work without a regular income.
ex.zh: 无薪实习可能使那些无法承受没有固定收入的学生处于不利地位。

tip: unpaid work指无偿工作；unpaid bills指未付账单。

senses.en: Serious and firm in demanding acceptable behaviour.
The back part of a boat or ship.

ex.en: Dad gave us a stern look across the table.
ex.zh: 爸爸隔着桌子严厉地看了我们一眼。

ex.en: Schools should combine stern warnings about bullying with practical support for students who experience it.
ex.zh: 学校既应严正警告欺凌行为，也应为遭受欺凌的学生提供实际支持。

tip: 形容词指态度严厉；作名词指船尾，与bow相对。

senses.en: Distance north or south of the equator, measured in degrees.
Freedom to choose how to act or decide.

ex.en: Our geography teacher showed us latitude on a globe.
ex.zh: 地理老师用地球仪给我们讲解纬度。

ex.en: Regions at higher latitudes generally experience greater seasonal variations in daylight than those near the equator.
ex.zh: 高纬度地区的日照时长通常比赤道附近地区有更明显的季节变化。

col: give someone latitude｜给予某人自主权
tip: latitude是纬度，longitude是经度。

senses.en: The planet second closest to the Sun.

senses.zh: 维纳斯，罗马爱与美之神
senses.en: The goddess of love and beauty in Roman mythology.

ex.en: We spotted Venus shining brightly just after sunset.
ex.zh: 日落后不久，我们看到了明亮的金星。

ex.en: Studying the thick atmosphere of Venus helps scientists understand how greenhouse gases influence planetary temperatures.
ex.zh: 研究金星浓厚的大气层有助于科学家理解温室气体如何影响行星温度。

col: the atmosphere of Venus｜金星的大气层
the surface of Venus｜金星表面
a mission to Venus｜金星探测任务
tip: 专有名词，首字母大写；金星通常不加冠词。

senses.en: belief in pursuing perfect standards, even when impractical
the philosophical view that reality depends on mind or consciousness

ex.en: Her idealism inspired us to clean the riverbank.
ex.zh: 她的理想主义鼓舞我们去清理河岸。

ex.en: Youthful idealism can encourage social change, but effective policies also require practical planning and reliable funding.
ex.zh: 年轻人的理想主义能推动社会变革，但有效的政策也需要务实的规划和可靠的资金。

col: youthful idealism｜年轻人的理想主义
a sense of idealism｜理想主义情怀
tip: 通常不可数；哲学语境译“唯心主义”。

senses.en: A tall upright pole supporting sails on a boat
A tall structure supporting equipment that sends or receives signals

ex.en: A white sail fluttered high on the wooden mast.
ex.zh: 一面白帆在木桅杆高处迎风飘动。

ex.en: Installing a new communications mast could improve mobile coverage in remote villages and support local businesses.
ex.zh: 安装新的通信塔可以改善偏远村庄的移动通信覆盖，并支持当地企业发展。

tip: 核心义是支撑帆的桅杆，也可指支撑天线的高杆。

senses.en: An area surrounded by a fence, wall, or other barrier.
Something placed inside an envelope together with a letter.
The act of surrounding land with a boundary.

ex.en: The goats rested in their enclosure beside the barn.
ex.zh: 山羊在谷仓旁的围栏里休息。

ex.en: Wildlife parks should provide each enclosure with enough space for animals to display natural behaviour.
ex.zh: 野生动物园应为每个围场提供足够空间，让动物展现自然行为。

tip: 纸质信函附件可用enclosure；邮件附件用attachment。

senses.en: In the direction of someone or something.
In relation to someone or something, especially in attitude.
Helping to achieve a goal or pay for something.

ex.en: The puppy ran towards me with its tail wagging.
ex.zh: 小狗摇着尾巴朝我跑来。

ex.en: Investment in public transport is an important step towards reducing air pollution in cities.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通是减少城市空气污染的重要一步。

col: work towards a goal｜努力实现目标
go towards the cost｜用于支付部分费用
tip: towards与toward意思相同；前者英式更常用。

senses.zh: 恳求，请求；申诉，答辩，辩护
为…辩护， 提出…为理由
闪亮， 闪烁； 闪现， 流露
可忽略不计的， 微不足道的

senses.en: An electric oven that heats food using electromagnetic waves
To cook or heat food in a microwave oven
A short electromagnetic wave used for heating and communication

ex.en: I heated yesterday's soup in the microwave for lunch.
ex.zh: 我用微波炉热了昨天的汤，当作午餐。

ex.en: Using a microwave to reheat small portions can consume less energy than using a conventional oven.
ex.zh: 用微波炉加热少量食物，比使用普通烤箱可能更节能。

col: microwave food｜用微波炉加热食物
tip: 作动词可直接接食物：microwave the soup。

senses.en: Impressive beauty, grandeur, or dignity that inspires admiration.
A title used when addressing or referring to a monarch.

ex.en: We stood silently, amazed by the majesty of the mountains.
ex.zh: 我们静静地站着，为群山的雄伟所震撼。

ex.en: Visitors drawn by the majesty of ancient temples can generate income for local conservation projects.
ex.zh: 被古寺的庄严壮丽吸引而来的游客能为当地保护项目带来收入。

col: the majesty of nature｜大自然的壮丽
tip: 表示“陛下”的称号时首字母大写：Majesty。
